summary: EPWK Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting (EGM) to be held on May 15, 2026. The agenda includes: (1) increasing authorized share capital from US$1,000,000 to US$40,000,000, creating 9 billion Class A and 1 billion Class B ordinary shares; (2) adopting amended articles to reflect the increase; and (3) reducing the par value of outstanding shares from US$0.004 to US$0.0001, transferring the resulting credit to a distributable reserve. No special-situation event is identified; the filing involves routine capital structure changes.
